narrative: A mid-sized pump manufacturer exports about 70% of its output to Europe. They buy pressure sensors from an established supplier, but lead times have stretched from 6 to 14 weeks over two quarters, causing two missed shipments. Their engineering lead reviewed our datasheet and confirmed the accuracy class and CE marking meet their requirements. The purchasing manager is open to alternatives but worries about field reliability because they have never used our brand.
label: propose_pilot_order
label_rationale: Specs are confirmed and the switching motive is strong, so the remaining barrier is product performance risk.

narrative: A large HVAC equipment maker has completed technical validation of our temperature sensors and issued an RFQ for 40,000 units per year. Their procurement team states our quote is 18% above their incumbent and asks for a matching price. The account manager's discount authority is capped at 8%. No technical or delivery concerns were raised in the last two meetings.
label: escalate_pricing
label_rationale: Price is the only remaining objection and the requested discount exceeds the account manager's authority.

narrative: A small startup building gas detection equipment for offshore platforms contacted us about proximity sensors. Their application requires ATEX Zone 0 certification. None of our current products carry that certification and there is no certification project on the roadmap. Expected volume is around 200 units per year.
label: disqualify
label_rationale: A mandatory certification is missing with no plan to obtain it, so time will not resolve the mismatch.

narrative: A medium-sized packaging machinery exporter asked for a quotation on displacement sensors after meeting us at a trade show. The contact is a junior engineer who says the project is urgent, but in a later email the purchasing department says there is no approved budget this fiscal year. The engineer also mentioned their current supplier's contract runs until next March. No technical requirements have been shared yet.
label: qualify_budget_authority
label_rationale: The urgency claim and the budget statement conflict and the contact lacks authority.

meta.ambiguity: engineer and purchasing disagree; nurture is defensible

narrative: A large mining equipment builder is satisfied with their current flow sensor supplier and signed a two-year supply agreement four months ago. Their engineering manager liked our product range at a conference and asked to be kept informed about new releases. There is no open project.
label: nurture
label_rationale: The fit is good but a recently signed supply agreement rules out a purchase in the near term.

narrative: A small food processing line integrator needs temperature sensors that tolerate washdown with caustic cleaning agents at 85 degrees. They sent a requirements sheet listing ingress protection, response time and cable material. Nobody on our side has checked the sheet against our product range yet. They plan to order within two months.
label: request_spec_review
label_rationale: Concrete technical requirements exist and the product fit has not been checked.
